provenance.draft: 4-round rookie draft, caption: 'This was done immediately after the veteran draft, which was done on aug 14th'
provenance.what_the_panel_is: The Sleeper PLAYERS tab (undrafted pool) rendered under the completed board. Filter chips read 'ALL 3/4', 'QB 1/1', 'RB 1/2', 'WR 1/2' - i.e. the entire undrafted pool at capture time was 4 players and 3 rows are on screen. The same 3 rows appear identically in all three images (the shots differ only in which board columns are scrolled into view).
provenance.legibility: ADP column fully legible for all 3 rows. PTS column is cut by the right screen edge after the decimal point in every shot ('43.' / '36.' / '35.'), so projected_points is recorded as illegible-with-partial and never completed. The 4th pool player is not visible in any of the three images.
provenance.what_this_is_not: This is NOT a broad ADP panel. It is 3 ADP values for deep-undrafted rookies (ADP 265-279). The corpus README's description ('undrafted-pool panel with ADP and projected points') is accurate in kind but the supply is 3 rows, not a ranking.
provenance.badge_key_as_read: purple 'R' badge = rookie flag; yellow 'Q' = injury designation (questionable). Transcribed as printed, not interpreted further.
